revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.2% (key_metrics); modest reacceleration to ~4% from store/online expansion, fading to 3% toward terminal growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held near FY2025 operating margin of 20.06% (key_metrics); FY2023-25 range 18.9%-20.1%, no further expansion assumed.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective tax proxy 22.4% (key_metrics); Damodaran Europe retail effective tax 23.5%.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 2,193 / revenue 39,864 = 5.5%; FY2024 5.7%. D&A includes lease depreciation while lease payments are not in capex, so FCF may be overstated; reviewer should consider.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 3.266% (ECB AAA 10Y, 2026-11-05) + beta 0.75 (Damodaran Europe Retail (Grocery and Food) cash-corrected unlevered beta 0.7497; ~0 D/E since Inditex debt is 2m vs large cash) x Spain ERP 5.782% (Damodaran, 2026-02-16) = 7.6%. Debt weight ~0 so WACC = cost of equity. Grocery retail used as industry proxy.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro-area inflation/nominal growth, below the risk-free rate of 3.27%.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 2 (current borrowings) - cash 5,276; no short-term investments reported; ESEF 549300TTCXZOGZM2EY83-2026-01-31-ESEF-ES-0; EUR millions
